sermon.title: A Test Sign: Why Do You Follow Jesus? — May 2, 2021
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer presents the feeding of the five thousand as a test: Jesus asked Philip where to buy bread, then fed thousands from a boy’s lunch. The crowd followed for loaves, not signs. Jesus told them to labor for food that endures, Himself the bread of life. His death activated an inheritance, and He asks why we follow Him.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.question: Are signs still part of God’s inheritance?
faqs.answer: Yes. Signs are still part of God’s inheritance, whether people use them wrongly and seek them wrongly or not.
